pages.text: BULLETIN From Atari Field Service ate August 30, 1983 ATARI © + verre communicanons Camoany STARWARS The Following Items Require Your Immediate Attention! ATARI Color X-¥Y Monitor (STAR WARS * only) High-Voltage Board Change capacitors C3 and C4 from 100 pF at 35 volts to 220 uF at 35 volts, with alow Equivalent Series Resistance (ESR) Rating. The Atari part number is 123009-227. The following manufacturers’ capacitors will work: Illinois Capacitor 227 RMR 050M (50 volts) Nichicon UPA1V221M (35 volts) Deflection Board When servicing the Deflection board, please change diodes CR2 and CRIl to Type-1N4148, Atari part number 131033-001. The old diodes (Type-1N914) will open, causing fuses F1 and F2 to blow. 1983 Lucasfilm Lid. & Atari, Inc. All rights reserved. Lucasfilm trademark used under license. 10183 (1/a2
